description: Draft Multiplication registry — derivative pleadings keyed to parent documents, with 50-subject applicability matrix.

derivative_types.label: Rejoinder
derivative_types.parent_relation: Responds to the opposite party's reply/counter, rebutting their preliminary objections and para-wise averments while reiterating the parent application's grounds.
derivative_types.when_filed: After the respondent's reply/counter is placed on record and before final hearing.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the parent application be allowed as prayed, the reply be rejected as evasive, and preliminary objections be overruled.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: Filing of rejoinder is generally permitted subject to the court's discretion; some High Court Rules require leave. Condone delay if filed beyond the prescribed interval.

terminology.closing: It is therefore prayed that the aforesaid application be allowed

derivative_types.label: Replication to Written Statement
derivative_types.parent_relation: Civil-stage response: admits/denies WS paras under Order VIII Rule 5, raises deemed non-denial, and rejoins specific denials to the plaint averments.
derivative_types.when_filed: Within the time fixed by the court after service of the written statement.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that denials in the WS be treated as evasive, facts in the plaint be deemed admitted under Order VIII Rule 5 CPC, and suit proceed to trial on issues.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: CPC Order VIII Rule 9; replication filed with court leave in some jurisdictions.

terminology.deemed_admission: Deemed admission under Order VIII Rule 5(1) CPC
terminology.closing: It is prayed that the written statement be taken as evasive and the suit be decreed

derivative_types.label: Counter-Affidavit
derivative_types.parent_of: writ petition / application sworn on affidavit
derivative_types.parent_relation: Respondent-side document: denies the petitioner's affidavit paras, states official facts with record references, and exhibits annexures.
derivative_types.when_filed: On the return date fixed by the court after notice issues.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the writ petition / application be dismissed with costs and interim relief be vacated.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: High Court Rules require para-wise denial; averments not specifically denied may be deemed admitted.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that the petition be dismissed with exemplary costs

derivative_types.label: Supplementary Application
derivative_types.parent_relation: Supplements the parent application with facts, events and documents arising after its filing, without disturbing the original cause of action.
derivative_types.when_filed: Any time after filing the parent application and before judgment, when subsequent facts materially affect adjudication.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the supplementary facts/documents be taken on record and read as part of the parent application.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: Courts permit supplementary pleadings to avoid multiplicity; documents must be relevant to the pre-existing cause of action.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that this supplementary application be taken on record along with the main application

derivative_types.label: Application for Amendment of Pleadings
derivative_types.parent_relation: Seeks leave to amend the parent pleading — adding causes of action, correcting parties, or updating relief — under the applicable amendment test.
derivative_types.when_filed: Before commencement of trial ideally; post-trial amendments need stricter justification.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the amendments per the annexed draft be allowed and the amended pleading be taken on record.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: CPC Order VI Rule 17 (proviso on duly-performed-inability after trial); limitation and prejudice to the opposite party are the governing tests.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that leave to amend be granted and the amended pleading be taken on record

derivative_types.label: Interim Stay / Interim Application
derivative_types.parent_relation: Seeks status-quo protection while the parent application remains pending — stay of operation, stay of proceedings, or interim direction.
derivative_types.when_filed: With the parent application or as soon as coercive/irreversible action is apprehended.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that operation or execution of the impugned order/ proceedings be stayed pending disposal of the parent application.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: Balance of convenience, prima facie case and irreparable injury are the triple test; of acquisition of lis pendens where property rights are involved.

terminology.response_para: Prima facie case and balance of convenience
terminology.closing: It is prayed that the impugned proceedings be stayed during the pendency of the main application

derivative_types.label: Review Application
derivative_types.parent_of: final judgment / order of the same court
derivative_types.parent_relation: Invokes the court's review jurisdiction on discovery of new evidence, apparent error on the face of the record, or other sufficient ground.
derivative_types.when_filed: Within the statutory limitation period from the date of the order reviewed (commonly 30/60 days).
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the order be reviewed and the error rectified by recalling, modifying or setting aside the operative portion.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: Review is not an appeal in disguise — cannot urge new arguments available at hearing; jurisdiction per Order XLVII CPC / Art. 137 Constitution / s. 391 BNSS-equivalents as applicable.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that the judgment and order be reviewed and set aside / modified

derivative_types.label: Appeal / Memo of Appeal
derivative_types.parent_of: final or interim order of the lower court/tribunal
derivative_types.parent_relation: Assails the parent order before the appellate forum, framing substantial questions / grounds of appeal and seeking reversal or remand.
derivative_types.when_filed: Within limitation from certification of the order/ decree; condonation application accompanies delayed filings.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the impugned order be set aside and the parent claim be allowed / matter remanded for fresh adjudication.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: Verify appellate forum, limitation and mandatory pre-deposit/stamping per the specific statute governing the parent proceeding.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that the appeal be allowed and the impugned order be set aside

derivative_types.label: Caveat
derivative_types.parent_of: anticipated application by the opposite party
derivative_types.parent_relation: Pre-emptive filing: asks the court to issue notice before entertaining any application the caveator's opponent may file.
derivative_types.when_filed: When there is apprehension that the opponent will move an ex-parte application.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that no order be passed on any application by the opponent without notice and an opportunity of hearing to the caveator.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: Section 148-A BNSS-equivalent / s. 148-A CPC; caveat survives for the statutory period.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that notice be given to the caveator before passing any order on any such application

derivative_types.label: Execution Application
derivative_types.parent_of: decree / final order in favour of the applicant
derivative_types.parent_relation: Enforces the parent decree: identification of decretal amounts/obligations, mode of execution, and attachments.
derivative_types.when_filed: After the decree becomes executable (within limitation for execution).
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the decree be executed by attachment/sale, arrest and detention, or other lawful mode against the judgment-debtor.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: CPC Order XXI; objections by judgment-debtor invite reply-stage drafting on the same family tree.

terminology.response_para: Particulars of the decree and mode of execution
terminology.closing: It is prayed that the decree be executed against the judgment debtor in the mode aforesaid

derivative_types.label: Application for Restoration
derivative_types.parent_relation: Seeks recall of the dismissal order and restoration of the parent case to the file, showing sufficient cause for non-appearance.
derivative_types.when_filed: Within 30 days of the dismissal (or with a condonation application thereafter).
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the dismissal order be set aside and the case be restored to its original number.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: CPC Order IX Rule 4/7/9 as applicable; sufficient cause is construed liberally but honestly.

terminology.closing: It is prayed that the case be restored to its original number and be decided on merits

derivative_types.label: Application for Additional Evidence
derivative_types.parent_relation: Seeks leave to place on record additional documents or witnesses that were not within knowledge or could not be produced despite diligence.
derivative_types.when_filed: At trial or appellate stage, before arguments conclude.
derivative_types.prayer_focus: Prays that the additional documents/witnesses listed in the schedule be summoned and taken on record.
derivative_types.jurisdiction_notes: CPC Order XLI Rule 27 test at appellate stage; due diligence is the touchstone.

terminology.response_para: Due diligence and relevance of additional evidence
terminology.closing: It is prayed that the additional evidence be permitted and taken on record
